query_text: what is the funnest terraria class

content.text:
The **funnest Terraria class** is usually **Summoner** — especially in mid-to-late game.

Why Summoner is so fun:
- You get an army of minions fighting for you.
- Whips make combat active instead of just passive.
- It feels very different from most other classes.
- You can focus on dodging while your summons shred bosses.
- Late-game summons like **Terraprisma**, **Stardust Dragon**, and **Stardust Cell** are extremely satisfying.

That said, it depends on what kind of fun you like:

| Class | Fun factor |
|---|---|
| **Summoner** | Best if you like pets, chaos, and dodging |
| **Mage** | Best if you like flashy weapons and variety |
| **Ranger** | Best if you like consistency and strong guns/bows |
| **Melee** | Best if you like tankiness and close combat |

My personal pick: **Summoner** for the most unique experience, with **Mage** as a close second because magic weapons are super creative.

If you’re new to Terraria, though, **Melee** or **Ranger** may feel smoother at first.
